description: This Java class provides helper methods for managing SharedPreferences in Android tests, including setting, clearing, and retrieving preference values, with integration to RxJava schedulers for flushing jobs.

classes.name: SharedPrefsHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing SharedPreferences during Android instrumented tests, allowing setting, clearing, and retrieving preference values with support for resource-based keys.

methods.name: setPrefsValue
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set preference values (String, boolean, int) using resource IDs or direct keys.

methods.name: clearPrefsValue
methods.description: Methods to remove preference entries by resource ID or key.

methods.name: getPrefValue
methods.description: Methods to retrieve preference values (boolean, int, String) with default values, using resource IDs.

methods.name: getSharedPreferences
methods.description: Returns the default SharedPreferences instance for the application context.
